case.summary: Case SEN-013 was opened on 2016-11-21 due to a Sentinel sweep identifying structuring on card C05851-K1 belonging to customer C05851. The investigation revealed four online purchases within 30 minutes totaling $1,911.84, with individual amounts kept just under $500. Graph analysis and the closed-case classifier yielded a fraud probability of 0.94 and a verdict of fraud. Consequently, recommended actions include BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, and FILE_REPORT.

sar.narrative: Customer C05851 holding card C05851-K1 was subjected to fraudulent activity involving four unauthorized online transactions. Four transactions totaling $1,911.84 occurred on 2016-11-21 between 10:00:00 and 10:30:00. The activity took place on 2016-11-21 through online channels in billing region 420.0. The transactions were executed using device profile C6743 Build/LMY47V | Android 5.1.1 | android browser 4.0 | 960x540. This activity is highly suspicious because the amounts were deliberately kept just under the $500 threshold and significantly exceeded the card's median spend. There are no connected cards associated with this incident. Recommended actions for this case include BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, and FILE_REPORT under policy guidelines.
